correctness.rationale: Specialized the actual source METD1 eq(7), METD2 eq(9), and METD2RK constant-forcing correction: K1_ij=f(d_i), K2_ij=f(d_i)+(d_i-d_j)g(d_i) with [Σ,A]=ΣA−AΣ. Exact solution is Gram(e^{-at},e^{-bt}) on [0,1], positive definite for a≠b. Strict decrease of f from its integral makes det sym(K1)=−(f(a)−f(b))²/4<0. sym(K2)_12=[f(a)+f(b)+(a−b)(g(a)−g(b))]/2, and dividing by a gives limit [[0,−g(b)/2],[−g(b)/2,0]] with g(b)>0. Continuity of real symmetric eigenvalues yields the claimed diverging negative slope. Independent finite tests rechecked METD determinant for five parameter pairs, stiffness slopes at a=100,1000,10000 and endpoint a=10,b=1; source tree blob SHA was independently reconstructed. Bounded tests corroborate but do not prove all a,b or the asymptotic.

value.rationale: Strong structure loss on a minimal 2-mode PSD rank-one Lyapunov source is scientifically motivated for covariance integration. The unbounded negative eigenvalue survives symmetrization while the exact Gram covariance remains bounded, a quantitative obstruction distinct from the trivial observation that a raw output may be nonsymmetric or that a method is not exactly congruence-preserving. The sharp slope permits stiffness-sensitive benchmarking and distinguishes method order from covariance validity. No claim to all integrators or fixed-operator h→0 instability.

final_claim: For published METD1/2/2RK full-matrix formulas applied to Qdot=AQ+QA+Σ, A=-diag(a,b), Σ=11^T, h=1, Q(0)=0, exact covariance Q(1) is positive definite for a!=b. The symmetric part of METD1 output has det=-(f(a)-f(b))^2/4<0, f(x)=(1-e^{-2x})/(2x). At fixed b>0, METD2=METD2RK and lim_(a→∞) λ_min(sym(K2(a,b)))/a= -g(b)/2<0, g(b)=[1-(1+b)e^{-b}]/b², while exact Q remains PSD and bounded.
limitations: Only real negative diagonal A with two rates, PSD rank-one constant Σ, zero initial covariance, and h=1 are proved.
Eigenvalue claims are for symmetric parts, not raw nonsymmetric update matrices; METD2 and 2RK agree only for constant forcing.
No fixed-A mesh-refinement divergence, no classification of all parameter thresholds, no assertion about other integrators or formal Lean/expert certification.
